simple.meaning: מוֹצָא (môwtsâʼ) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a going forth , i.e. (the act) an egress , or (the place) an exit ; hence, a source or product ; specifically, dawn , the rising of the sun (the East ), exportation , utterance , a gate , a fountain , a mine , a meadow (as producing grass).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 27 times across Numbers, Deuteronomy, 2 Samuel, 1 Kings, 2 Kings, and 8 more, beginning at Numbers 30:13. Its contexts include family, family line, commandment, kingship, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מוֹצָא (H4161).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: מוֹצָא (môwtsâʼ) / H4161 is traced through Numbers 30:13, Numbers 33:2, Deuteronomy 8:3, Deuteronomy 23:24 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.short: a going forth , i.e. (the act) an egress , or (the place) an exit ; hence, a source or product ; specifically, dawn , the rising of the sun (the East ), exportation , utterance , a gate , a fountain , a mine , a meadow (as producing grass)
definitions.usage: brought out, bud, that which came out, east, going forth, goings out, that which (thing that) is gone out, outgoing, proceeded out, spring, vein, (water-) course (springs).
definitions.full: H4161. motsa I. מוֺצָא noun masculine Hosea 6:3 place or act of going forth, issue, export, souce, spring ; — absolute ׳מ Job 28:1 ; Psa 75:7 ; construct ׳מ Num 30:13 9 t.; מֹצָא Job 38:27 ; Dan 9:25 ; suffix מוֺצָאֲךָ 2Sam 3:25 ; מֹצָאוֺ Hosea 6:3 ; מוֺצָאוֺ Psa 19:7 ; plural construct מוֺצָאֵי Isa 41:18 5 t.; suffix מוֺצָאָיו Ezek 43:11 ; מוֺצָאֵיהֶם Num 33:2 (twice in verse); מוֺצָאֵיהֶן Ezek 42:11 ; — 1 a going forth: a. the act, of ׳י Hosea 6:3 ; of the sun = rising Psa 19:7 (see יצא 1f ); of man 2Sam 3:25 (opposed to מָבוֺא Kt); ׳מ דָּבָר Dan 9:25 going forth of a command. b. concrete , גּוֺלָה מוֺצָאֵי Ezek 12:4 goings forth of exile, i.e. those going forth into exile (in simile). c. way out, exit: concrete, of chambers in temple Ezek 42:11 ; 43:11 (opposed to מוֺבָאָיו ); הַמִּקְדָּשׁ מוֺצָאֵי 44:5 (opposed to הַבַּיִת מְבוֺא ). 2 that which goes forth: a. utteranc of mouth or lips (especially of solemn or formal speech), פִייֿ ׳מוֺצָא Deut 8:3 ; מ ׳שְׂפָתַי Jer 17:16 ; Psa 89:35 ; so Deut 23:24 ; Num 30:13 (P). b. export of horses 1Kin 10:23 2Chr 1:16 . 3 place of going forth: a. source or spring of water 2Kin 2:21 ; Isa 58:11 (in simile) Psa 107:33 (|| נְהָרוֺת ), 107:35 (|| אֲגַםמֿים ) = Isa 41:18 (|| id. ); הָעֶלְיוֺן גִיחוֺן מֵימֵי מוֺצָא 2Chr 32:30 . b. place of departure of Israel on marchNum 2Chr 33:2 (twice in verse) (P). c. מוֺצָא = east (place of sun's going forth) Psa 75:7 (opposed to מַעֲרָב ); zeugmatically, 65:9 וָעֶרֶב בֹּקֶר מוֺצָאֵי i.e. the east and the west (compare the two Orients , Qor 43:37). d. place whence silver comes = mine Job 28:1 ; דֶשֶׁא מֹצָא וּלְהַצְמִיחַ 38:27 and to cause the growing-place (others, the growth ) of young grass to sprout.
